full_judgment: 6. In the Writ Petition, the petitioner has traced the devolution of the property in question for about a hundred years. The property originally belonged to one Siddheswari Debi of Kayettully, Dhaka. She sold the said property to one Sonatan Nielsen by registered sale deed No. 3859 for the year 1895. Sonatan Maisan sold the property to Du lat Maisani by registered sale deed No. 2372 for the year 1898. After her death, her successors-in-interest sold the property to Kali Mohan Das by registered sale deed No. 3446 for the bear 1906. Kali Mohan Das sold it to Sreemati Sukhada Sundary Shome by registered sale deed No. 1387 dated 15.3.1914 (photocopy is Annexure A). The said property was marked as plot No. 146 under khatian No. 15837 in Mouza Shahar Dhaka. After the preparation of C.S. Khatian Sreemati Sukhada Sundary Shome was recorded as owner thereof. Photocopies of the C.S. map and C.S. Khatian are Annexures B and C respectively. The successive heirs of Sreemati Sukhada Sundary Shome exchanged the said property with the properties of the petitioner's predecessor-in-interest Musammat Nek Khatun Begum situated at 13 Mominpur, Alipore, District 24 Parganas, West Bengal, India by registered deed of exchange No. 1162 dated 10.2.59 (photocopy of the deed of exchange is Annexure D). Musammat Nek Khatun Begurn mutated her name in the Government's revenue records and paid rents upto 1930. Photocopies of S.A. Khatian and rent receipts are Annexures E and F respectively. Musammat Nek Khatun Begum also mutated her name in the municipal records, WASA and Electricity authority and paid Municipal taxes, WASA and electric bills since the day of acquisition of her title in the said property upto 1980. The municipal and other records are Annexures G, H, I and J. Musammat Nek Khatun Begum not only possessed the said property personally but also let out a part thereof under a written lease deed, photocopy of which is Annexure K. At the time of hearing Mr. Syed Ishtiaq Ahmed, learned Advocate for the petitioner produced before us the original copies of all the Annexures A-V for our inspection and satisfaction.
